emulator.name: DOSBox Staging

video.capture: physical 0xa0000, 64000 palette indices, grayscale visualization only

emulator.input_method: linear writes into game keyboard state; unique C-runtime anchor and 320x200 data-field validation; no LDT-descriptor, IRQ1 or host keyboard validation

scenarios.repeatability: turn observed; final heading differs across timed repetitions

scenarios.attempt_only: Space/Ctrl were injected from the unarmed initial route; no successful door interaction or shot evidenced.

scenarios.attempt_only: Space/Ctrl were injected from the unarmed initial route; no successful door interaction or shot evidenced.

runs.keyboard_data_offsets_source: script equivalent; RU01 predates explicit report offsets

limitations: Only initial LEVEL1, in-place turning and short forward movement are evidenced. Late scenarios remain planned or pending.
Earlier WASDify profiler used modified diagnostic RUS EXEs; its FPS is not a G00 measurement.
Keyboard-state injection does not validate host keyboard events or guest IRQ1 handling.
DPMI selectors must be resolved through descriptors; numeric memory API segments use real-mode segment*16.
Private game copies, frames and memory dumps under build/reference are excluded from Git and distribution.
Framebuffer PNG files visualize palette indices as grayscale; actual VGA palette and audio are not captured.
Timed input is not frame-synchronized; final headings and movement distances differ across repeats and are not proof of language-specific speed differences.

input_protocol.make: state[scan]=3; increment uint16 pending count; set last scancode
input_protocol.timebase: host wall clock; not deterministic game ticks

supplementary_observations.limitation: short forward movement is not wall-following scenario acceptance

script.state: final_script_after_report_series; earlier reports retain their actual commands

configuration_isolation.earlier_log_note: primary configuration absent; own config recorded per report

post_run_source_verification.timing: after successful replays; not substituted for historical per-run records
